title-group.article-title: Projections of the basolateral amygdala to the central nucleus in the mouse

abstract.p: We injected an anterograde tracer into the basolateral amygdala of adult mice and mapped labelled axons. Dense terminal fields were found in the medial central nucleus, and sparse fibres in the lateral central nucleus.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Animals were anaesthetised with isoflurane and placed in a stereotaxic frame. AAV-hSyn-EGFP (50 nl) was injected unilaterally into the basolateral amygdala, and brains were collected three weeks later.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Every injection labelled axons in the ‮AEC laidem‬, with fewer in its lateral part.
No labelled terminals were found in the medial amygdala in any animal.
